counterarguments.text: A reader might confuse Bank of America's row in Table 6 with adjacent banks (e.g., Bank of NY-Mellon at 11.2/14.8/11.6) because compressed PDF columns can misalign; however, both Table 6 and the bank-specific appendix table agree on 11.9/10.7/10.2 for Bank of America.

limitations: The source text is a partial excerpt of the PDF; the full bank name 'Bank of America Corporation' is truncated at the start of the appendix excerpt (' of America Corporation'), so full-name coverage relies on context.
Excerpts are not the whole source; Table 6 columns are compressed and ordering was verified against the aligned Appendix A table.
The report's publication date is not shown in the excerpts; the 2024:Q4 actual and 2025:Q1–2027:Q1 projection periods are as declared in the table headings.
Projections are Federal Reserve estimates under a hypothetical severely adverse scenario, not forecasts of actual outcomes.
